spend_programs.description: Clinic manager purchasing: medical supplies, cleaning supplies, small equipment and emergency repairs. $4,000 per month with a $1,000 per-transaction cap; purchases above $1,000 route through procurement. The prohibited vendor is blocked at merchant level on this programme.
Travel for the two regional operations directors: hotels, flights, rental cars and meals. $3,000 per month. The prohibited vendor is blocked at merchant level on this programme.
Facilities repairs and contractors. $2,500 per month. The prohibited vendor is blocked at merchant level on this programme.

Contract nurse assignment expenses: lodging near the clinic, meals and fuel. $1,500 per month. Each nurse limit carries a lock date set to the assignment end date, satisfying REQ-4. The prohibited vendor is blocked at merchant level on this programme.
